continuation.text:
I removed the "at least one resource must remain unallocated" check from `src/solution.py`. Before, an allocation that fit within capacity but used up every resource returned `False`. Now it returns `True`, and the only capacity test left is that no resource's total demand exceeds its capacity.

Everything else is unchanged, including the input validation and the function signature. I did not run anything, and I did not write any checks under `checks/`.
